verdict.rationale: Terraform is itself an official CLI with documented commands and strong agent-friendly traits. It offers machine-readable `-json` output streams for plan/apply/test, `show -json` for plans and state, and `-auto-approve` for non-interactive applies. Saved plan files (`-out`) and Unix-tool-friendly state commands round this out, and community users corroborate everyday CLI use such as `terraform state mv` and `terraform apply`. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence of AI agents driving the CLI specifically, and any AI-specific CLI mode or guidance.
